description: Ministry of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs - Duties & Functions assigned to the Deputy Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs w.e.f. 01.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (Deputy Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs) and provides detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities and functions, including formulation of tourism programs, registration processes, domestic tourism promotion, Christian religious affairs, hotel regulation, and human resource training. This combination of a named person with detailed ministerial responsibilities qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
